# go-modern-slices-max-min

**Since:** Go 1.21

## Summary

Use slices.Max and slices.Min instead of manual loops over ordered values.

## Details

slices.Max and slices.Min capture the common non-empty-slice scan for an ordered maximum or minimum.
Keep explicit logic when empty slices or custom comparison rules need special handling.

## Examples

### Before

```go
maxValue := values[0]
for _, value := range values[1:] {
  if value > maxValue {
    maxValue = value
  }
}
```

### After

```go
maxValue := slices.Max(values)
```
